svg.aria-label: One frame of the ocean. Wind feeds the spectrum pass, which makes h0 only when a setting changes. Time and h0 feed animate, then FFT, then assemble. Assemble writes the displacement map for the surface vertex shader and normals plus foam for the surface fragment shader, and feeds the preview pass.
